newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark's Pedersen wins Czech contract.
newsitem.headline: Denmark's Pedersen wins Czech contract.

text.p: Danish roadbuilder Marius Pedersen said on Wednesday that it had won a Czech government contract, worth a total 200 million crowns, to clean the areas around Skoda vehicle plants,
The project centres on removal of soil and water, polluted by years of heavy industry and is expected to be completed by the year 2003 a Pedersen statement said.

Pedersen has bid for much bigger Danish road and roofing company Phoenix Contractors but its offer is now the lowest of three rival bids and it has said that it will not pay more. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
